mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.product_id, c.spec_id, c.quantity, c.checked, c.create_time, c.update_time, p.name AS product_name, p.cover_image AS product_image, ps.spec_text, ps.price, ps.stock FROM cart c LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN product_spec ps ON ps.id = c.spec_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId}
